definitions: To produce or provide (a natural, agricultural, or industrial product).
To give way to pressure, an argument, or a demand.
To produce a result or profit.
To give up one's position of advantage or right.
To bend or break under force.
examples: The land yields a good harvest.
He refused to yield to their demands.
The company yielded a profit last year.
The old bridge might yield under the weight.
She yielded her seat to an elderly woman.
